page_title: Vorssaint — The modular Swiss Army knife for macOS

summary.name: Vorssaint
summary.one_liner: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that bundles many small utilities (window control, clipboard history, volume mixer, system monitor, cleaner, and more) that you can install or remove individually.
use_cases: switch windows and apps faster on macOS
keep the Mac awake during tasks
clean caches and uninstall apps with leftovers
summary.what_it_does: Vorssaint is a menu bar app for macOS organized as modular tools: you install only the ones you want, and uninstalling one removes it from the app. Feature groups cover windows and the Dock (app switcher, Dock previews, window layout and snapping), mouse and keyboard (scroll inversion, smooth and linear scrolling, side-button mapping, text snippets), clipboard and files (local clipboard history, Finder cut and paste, Shelf), and sound (per-app volume mixer, output switching, microphone mute). It also offers a Dynamic Island-style panel for music, timers, calendar and AI agent status, a system monitor covering CPU, GPU, memory, network, disks, power and fans, and tools such as a cleaner, uninstaller, screenshot and screen recording, and a Kill Process and Port Manager. The page says everything is kept local.
notable: Modular: uninstalling a feature removes it from the whole app and stops it loading
Open source and installable via Homebrew cask (brew install --cask vorssaint)
Broad scope: window management, mouse/keyboard tweaks, clipboard, audio mixer, system monitor, and Dynamic Island panel in one app
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon
Some features depend on other tools, e.g. Port Manager needs Kill Process installed to terminate processes
Dynamic Island is optional and some features (e.g. Fan Control, temperature readings) may depend on hardware, which the page does not detail
